changes.before: return {group:g, ring, beacons:beaconGroups, dish, pos:g.position, site, name:site.name, scale:site.scale, rot:site.rot, r:Ro*site.scale, main:!!site.main};
for (const c of colonies){ scene.remove(c.group); c.group.traverse(o=>{ if (o.geometry) o.geometry.dispose(); }); }
changes.after: for (const c of colonies){ window.BeltRunnerGardenColony?.release(c); scene.remove(c.group); c.group.traverse(o=>{ if (o.geometry && !o.userData.gardenShared) o.geometry.dispose(); }); }
